claims.finding: ClickCommand invokes CommandSetter.Operation then SetParamUnit; ExcuteMethodOperation reflects the requested method name on Executor.TargetObj or parent NameValueItem. Commands are explicit model actions, not UI strings that imply execution.

SelfExcuteModule checks procedure busy, owner VmModule readiness and solution loading, clears every display object value cache, then owner.Run(). ExecuteBottomCommand.IsBusy targets its procedure, unlike base BottomCommand global IsBusy.

references.excerpt: protected override bool IsBusy => (Procedure as IVMRun)?.IsRunning ?? false;

claims.finding: VmModule.Run calls native ModuleManager.SelfRun(nodeID). For non-continuous self-run it sets root inner-module self-running and module IsRunning. Exception clears those flags. It is not a host call to execute the entire flow; native dependency scheduling beyond this boundary remains unaudited here.

Continuous execution is callback-gated: set solution IsContinuousSelfExecute, subscribe ModuleResultCallBackArrived, start a long-running task looping with Thread.Sleep(300). Each tick waits when previous callback absent or root running; it clears display stores and calls module.Run only when allowed.

Stop command only clears shared solution IsContinuousSelfExecute. StopContinuousSelfExecute cancels, joins owned task, unsubscribes module callback and resets callback gate; this is not an arbitrary1ms UI loop.

Controls write live values before triggering optional execution. Boolean ValueChanged requires actual old/new difference and SetParamUnit success. NameValueItem inherits category CanTriggerRun; PreExecuteRun is gated by global IsParamModifyExecute and FilterPreRun. ExecuteRun suppresses during solution running, clears display cache, then module.Run.

references.excerpt: public bool CanTriggerRun = false;

claims.finding: Window Closed clears continuous-self-execute flag, unregisters shared camera/light/comm functions, calls root.Dispose and DoFinish. Dispose only closes subscription window state; DoFinish traverses tabs; there is no generic native algorithm reset in these shown methods; tool-specific finishers require separate audit.
DoIniter traverses all tabs and both command collections and extern params, then clears SelectedSubscribeParam; lifecycle initialization is not only setting textbox defaults.

If visible and invoked, reset checks unsupported module list, asks explicit confirmation, resets run-param bindings then native owner.ResetParam, refreshes model values and shows success; it is not simply replacing all JSON defaults and retained algorithm cache.

contractObligations: Retain one parsed per-node model independently of window lifetime; keep tab/visibility/control/command state separate from native algorithm state.
Window factory must expose modeless ownership/reuse/geometry/bottom strips and ROI surface association; no full-screen image-editor assumption.
Ordered top tabs, categories, externally linked groups, control templates, value/subscription operations, initializers and explicit commands are declarative schema data.

Execution service must distinguish ApplyValue, conditional parameter-modified self-run, explicit single self-run, callback-gated continuous self-run, stop, and close; do not map all edits to full workflow execution.
Shared display object definitions/configuration and rendering live outside algorithm output schemas.
Close/dispose must stop self-run and subscriptions while respecting tool-specific finishers; do not infer a native algorithm reset or a second apply transaction from generic root disposal.
unverified: No modeless original desktop window was opened/clicked by this audit. Original control parser/shape methods were controlled separately in rotate evidence.
Native ModuleManager.SelfRun dependency scheduling is beyond the managed boundary shown.
Exact screenshot parity, fractional font renderer behavior, and unknown custom-control templates remain separate obligations.
The cached tab model is proven in memory; persistence of selected tab across saving/loading a solution is not proven here.
implementationDirective: Primary agent owns unified model contract and host implementation. This report makes no changes to existing window appearance or shared host code.
